summary: The approved public contract and macOS extraction are delivered, but the independent review found two current-scope follow-ups: queued ready operations need explicit failure semantics, and file-selection completion needs one-shot/close-safe guarding. Public paths remain backend-independent and GUI evidence remains limited.

gaps.title: Guard asynchronous host completions and ready failures
gaps.why_it_matters: Duplicate or late host completion can reach WK after close; queued ready operations can be silently dropped on initialization failure.

assumptions: GUI-only claims remain limited until a logged-in macOS session with screens is available.
human_required_blockers: Run webview_macos_view_tests in a GUI-capable macOS session to observe real view/popup geometry and bridge E2E.

outcome_answers.answer: Yes for public/demo/cross-platform paths: static scan found no Wk concrete casts or platform includes; the only cast remains inside the macOS backend popup implementation.
outcome_answers.boundary: The private macOS backend cast remains allowed.
outcome_answers.next_action: Keep future backend code behind the public contract.

outcome_answers.answer: Mostly: public IWebView and WebViewTypes express initialization, attach/detach, navigation/bridge state consumption, popup ownership, host file/download callbacks, and explicit resource mappings; queued failure and completion guards need HOST-03.
outcome_answers.boundary: HOST-03 remains open for asynchronous failure and completion safety.

outcome_answers.answer: Core and macOS session suites pass (2/2); the full view suite aborts before window creation because no screens are available, so real GUI navigation/popup/bridge E2E is not claimed.
outcome_answers.boundary: GUI-only behavior was not observed in this environment.
outcome_answers.next_action: Run the view suite in a logged-in WindowServer session.

outcome_answers.answer: CMake source selection and WebViewFactory use platform branches/macros; static scan found no runtime registry, plugin loader, dlopen, or LoadLibrary path.
outcome_answers.boundary: Evidence is for the current macOS configuration.
outcome_answers.next_action: Reuse the same compile-time boundary for Windows implementation.
